issues.title: Missing Play button on launcher
issues.author: Billabong1985
issues.body: Launcher is missing a Play button on the games tab for me, there is a Play button on the mods tab which allows the game to launch fine even with no mods added. This is the amd64 AppImage running on a steam deck

issues.title: HD texture pack compatibility?
issues.author: Billabong1985
issues.body: On PCSX2 I use HD texture packs for the Ratchet and Clank games, are there any plans to make this project compatible with texture packs like these?
